name: Orthopedic Physiotherapy
description: Orthopedic Physiotherapy helps patients recover from musculoskeletal conditions including knee pain, back pain, neck pain, frozen shoulder, arthritis, ligament injuries, fractures, post-operative rehabilitation and mobility problems. Dr Jhatka Medicare provides professional home physiotherapy across Lucknow with personalized treatment plans.
shortDescription: Home physiotherapy for knee, back, neck, shoulder, hip, ankle, elbow, wrist, fracture and joint rehabilitation.

name: Neurological Physiotherapy
description: Neurological Physiotherapy helps patients recover movement, balance, coordination and muscle strength after stroke, paralysis, facial palsy, Parkinson's disease, spinal cord injury, neuropathy and other neurological conditions. Home physiotherapy service available across Lucknow.
shortDescription: Stroke, paralysis, facial palsy, Parkinson's disease, spinal cord injury and nerve-related rehabilitation.

name: Sports Physiotherapy
description: Sports Physiotherapy focuses on the prevention, treatment and rehabilitation of sports-related injuries. It helps recover from ligament injuries, muscle strains, sprains, ACL and meniscus injuries, tendon pain, shoulder injuries and ankle injuries. Dr Jhatka Medicare provides sports physiotherapy and home rehabilitation services across Lucknow for athletes, fitness enthusiasts and active individuals.
shortDescription: Physiotherapy for sports injuries, ligament tears, muscle strain, tennis elbow, ACL injury and athletic rehabilitation.

name: Pediatric Physiotherapy
description: Pediatric Physiotherapy helps infants, children and teenagers improve movement, balance, coordination and muscle strength. It is useful for developmental delay, cerebral palsy, autism spectrum disorders, torticollis, flat feet, walking difficulties and other pediatric neurological or orthopedic conditions. Dr Jhatka Medicare provides child-friendly home pediatric physiotherapy services across Lucknow.
shortDescription: Specialized physiotherapy for babies and children with developmental delay, cerebral palsy, autism, muscle weakness and walking problems.

description: Women's Health Physiotherapy provides safe and specialized care for women during pregnancy, after delivery and throughout different stages of life. Dr Jhatka Medicare offers women's health home physiotherapy services across Lucknow.
shortDescription: Specialized physiotherapy for pregnancy, post-delivery recovery, pelvic floor weakness, urinary leakage and women's health conditions.

name: Geriatric Physiotherapy
